title: Sum of Even Numbers
description:
Read a single line of space-separated integers and print the sum of only the even numbers.

Input Format
A single line with space-separated integers.

Output Format
A single integer — the sum of the even numbers (print 0 if there are none).

Constraints
1 <= count of numbers <= 100

Examples
Input: 1 2 3 4 5 6
Output: 12

Input: 1 3 5
Output: 0
starterCode:
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Write your solution here

Output Format

title: FizzBuzz
description:
Read an integer N and print the numbers from 1 to N, one per line, but:
- print "Fizz" if the number is divisible by 3,
- print "Buzz" if divisible by 5,
- print "FizzBuzz" if divisible by both 3 and 5,
- otherwise print the number itself.

Input Format
A single integer N.

Output Format
N lines following the rules above.

Example
Input: 5
Output:
1
2
Fizz
4
Buzz
